profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Disney
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
Hi all, I am Morgan Lee. 

👋🏾I recently graduated with a B.S in Computer Science from Spelman College (C'2025).

💻I have experience building software prototypes and deep-learning algorithms. I am interested in opportunities in Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Program Management, or UX/UI Design. 

🗣With the strong leadership foundation Spelman has instilled in me and the skills and guidance of my tech community, I aspire to grow into a well-rounded Software Engineer. I seek to bring more women into STEM by making elementary-high school STEM programs more accessible and breaking down stereotypes that may intimidate a diverse crowd. 

 🌊When I'm not behind a computer, I'm running, reading, or exploring new cities!

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Spring 2025 Software Engineer Intern in McKinsey’s One Data Pillar (Data Engineering). 
- Developed a real-time data streaming pipeline using Python and Apache Kafka to process and analyze large-scale data efficiently. Implemented Kafka producers and consumers to enable seamless ingestion and transformation of high-volume data streams.

positions.title: Tech Fellow
positions.description:
- Selected as one of 1,000 for an 18-month professional development program for high-achieving diverse talent.
- Participate in conferences hosted by industry leaders, such as Deloitte, Google, Bloomberg, LinkedIn and Target.

positions.title: Applied Mathematician/Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Prototyped a Process Orchestration Software with Apache Airflow using Python and Bash scripts that ran multiple processes simultaneously and several different configurations.
- Implemented Apache Airflow with custom software which mitigated previous cyber vulnerabilities and extended the functionality of the current custom-built orchestration software
positions.insights: Skills: Apache Airflow · Python (Programming Language) · Linux · XML

company.name: The Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory

positions.title: Applied Mathematician/Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Researched ways to predict the destination of a moving target using Machine Learning techniques.
- Created a deep learning algorithm with tracking vessels by implementing an LSTM model that fuses AIS data (time-series data) and Bathymetry data (imagery-like data) to produce track predictions with an 89% accuracy.

company.name: The Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description:
- Partnering with Mathematical Statistician at the U.S. Census Bureau, Dr. Andrea Roberson 
- Engaging in a virtual semester-long reading project on the Fundamentals of Accelerated Data Science

company.name: The Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description:
I am so happy to announce that I will be interning this summer with The Johns Hopkins Applied Physics Laboratory (APL) in Maryland! I will be working as an APL Intern in the Force Projector Sector.  

I would like to give a special thanks to Zerotti Woods and those who helped me immensely throughout this process, I could not have done it without their support and guidance. I look forward to diving into this new opportunity and cannot wait to join the team!

positions.title: Applied Mathematician/Engineer Intern
positions.description: - Engineering Intern for the Force Projection Sector where they develop advanced technologies that revolutionize the US military’s ability to prosecute long-range engagements against challenging tactical targets in land, maritime, and air.

positions.title: Head Summer Camp Counselor
positions.description:
- Organized and led a variety of small (15+ campers) and large (30+ campers) group activities, including camp-wide Scavenger Hunt, Field Day, and daily recreational activities.
- Mediated conflicts between campers and Counselors in Training with a discussion between involved parties and a resolution adherent to camp policies.

honors.title: Grace Hopper Scholar
honors.issuer: Issued by Grace Hopper Celebration (GHC) · May 2023

projects.title: Research: An Application of Artificial Intelligence and Text Analysis in Federal Statistics
projects.description: Researched a survey on national-level estimates of U.S. businesses' annual capital investment in new and used buildings, structures, machinery, and equipment. Examined the efficacy of Machine Learning techniques in classifying text data from the survey and presented possible ways to increase intelligent predictions to the Mathematics Department of Spelman College.

organizations.name: National Society of Black Engineers, AUC Chapter
organizations.description:
- Collaborated with fellow Executive Board members on launching General Body Meetings, Technical Interview Workshops, and community service projects that reached 90+ college students.
- Coordinated NSBE networking events and conferences between national and local chapters along with connecting STEM professionals and students alike in the engineering field.

organizations.name: Girl Power
organizations.description:
- Uplift and empower groups of 15+ elementary school-aged girls in the West End Atlanta community by providing weekly lunch mentorship and after-school programs.
- Reached over 40 young girls through mentorship and built them up with a self-esteem that boosted their confidence and engagement in school and daily life.
